item.title: Exploring visionOS
item.description:
Introduction

I find myself fascinated by the idea of creating an app for visionOS where I could possibly display 3D AirPods that I like. Here are a few steps on how you can do the same:

First step

The first step that you need to do is to create a visionOS project.

Second step

The next step would be adding a 3D object to Reality Composer Pro and exporting it as a .usdz file. You can download free 3D objects here. All you need to do to download content is to register on this site.
